title: Conditional kappa 0.001246073505487942: rank138 kernel with idle-data hosting
body:
Draft conditional **κ = 0.001246073505487942**, **0.06266595% above our preceding hosted result** and **0.68859927% above #442** at `4e16d001d505d4f21dd2bcfc44591f9be4c279bd`.

Compose #443's rank-138 kernel with 32 bit replicas and #442's idle-data hosting. **This inherits #442's additional hosting operator extension of the dirty-bank/compressed-window interface.** Finite combinatorial checks do not prove that extension. All earlier all-size compiler, restored-work, tape/common-grid, precision and analytic assumptions remain; no unconditional theorem or new Lean proof is claimed.

The pinned #443 word has 114 pivots, 103 donor slots, 57 A-frame changes and the two #441 B-frame witnesses. Its scalar/source-span reconstruction passes. The full bit emitter checks all 7,620 one-replica global columns and emits 288 invocations and 213,120 helper assignments; an independent audit checks exact projectors, reflected programs, all owners and residual isometries. Hosting leaves **37,464 live / 37,473 physical bit families**, **159,168 hosted residuals** and deficit **9,984**. Complex remains eight replicas, 8,400 live families, 34,560 hosted residuals and deficit 2,496. The bit side binds.

**Passed:** pinned local reconstruction, changed bit emission, independent global audit, both hosted-template audits and nine hosting mutations, both exact moment engines, a fresh 32-replica finite invoice retaining the 144-factor route bound plus two hosting factors, six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities. Next κ grid point rejected. Negative searches, the upstream shell-path failure and a local disk-full interruption are retained.

**Full local verification PASS:** uninterrupted Python 3.11.15 and 3.14.8 wrappers at `d21614a4e458b99d1d897eebb6c30370f9aa06f1`; exact tested manifest, receipts, parent receipts, audits and logs are in `research/e8-rank138-idle-hosting/local-evidence/`. This follow-up updates documentation and evidence only. **GitHub CI remains pending.** #444 independently reports the same κ; this shared numerical lead requires the additional hosting extension and is not a stronger result under only #441’s pre-hosting assumptions. Reproduce with `python -B research/e8-rank138-idle-hosting/verify.py /absolute/new/output` (standard library only). It freshly replays the parent, including all 2,918 selected complex Gaussian phase edges. The previous hosted result 0.001245293130733870 remains fully verified on Python 3.11/3.14 with receipts under `research/e8-r740-idle-hosting/local-evidence/`.

Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit chafreaky #443/#417/#439, eumemic #436/#440/#441, #442 idle-data hosting with Claude assistance, Rohan Arun #434/#435/#438, icekylinx #433, the retained #426/#389/#376/#370, #425/#386 and Jacob Sussman contributions. Exact source pins, licenses and assistance disclosures are retained.
